metricModel.label: Clarity
metricModel.why: Shows whether the promise is understandable in seconds and whether the page is ready for cold traffic.

metricModel.label: CTA System
metricModel.why: Measures how clearly the page drives one primary next step without branching into chaos.

metricModel.label: Proof
metricModel.why: Checks whether the page earns trust with results, specificity, process, credibility, or grounded evidence.

metricModel.label: Offer Depth
metricModel.why: Captures whether the page explains formats, fit, pricing, objections, and what happens next.

metricModel.label: Scannability
metricModel.why: Tests whether the page is easy to scan, section by section, without copy overload.

metricModel.label: Focus
metricModel.why: Flags friction from too many navigation exits, too many CTA variants, or weak decision guidance.

metricModel.label: Technical
metricModel.why: Combines layout stability, markup quality, audit results, and accessibility/search hygiene.
